data.long_meaning: Divashree is a Sanskrit name that translates to 'Goddess of divine grace'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'diva' meaning 'god' and 'shree' meaning 'grace'. In Hindu mythology, Divashree represents the divine feminine energy and is revered as the goddess of prosperity, happiness, and grace. The name Divashree carries the meaning “Goddess of divine grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Divashree usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of divine grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
